probabilityNa: Probability does not apply to Assumption, Issue and Dependency entries

register.title: RAID log (T15)
register.intro: Risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies of this transformation (Template 15). A Dependency entry is the same record as the T08 dependency map: there is no second copy.
register.tableIntro: Probability is High, Medium or Low for a Risk and n/a for the other types. New entries are Open.
register.dependencyClosed: Resolved in the dependency map (T08); its closure note is in the dependency's record history.
register.emptyBody: Log a risk, an assumption, an issue or a dependency to start the RAID log.

form.createIntro: Choose the type first. A Dependency needs the initiative it depends on ('To').
form.probabilityHint: Only a Risk has a probability.
form.fromHint: The initiative that depends on another. Leave empty if it is the transformation as a whole.
form.toHint: The initiative this depends on. Required for a Dependency.
form.dependencyEditIntro: A Dependency entry is Open until it is closed; it has no 'In progress'. Changes here change the T08 dependency.
form.closeIntro: A closed entry can no longer be changed.
form.dependencyCloseIntro: Closing a Dependency resolves the T08 dependency. The note is kept in its record history.

actions.title: Action register
actions.intro: Owned actions of this transformation with their source, due date and follow-up date.
actions.tableIntro: Overdue actions are flagged. The source links to the record the action belongs to.
actions.emptyBody: Actions are added from a RAID entry, a corrective action or a meeting.

corrective.title: Corrective actions
corrective.intro: Recovery plans opened when a KPI or benefit stays off track, a check fails or a Value Review finds a problem. An open case is updated, never duplicated.
corrective.tableIntro: The owner is Unassigned when no person could be resolved. A follow-up date is Unknown when no working-day calendar exists.
corrective.createIntro: A person opens a case for a Value Review finding. Cases for KPIs, benefits and failed checks are opened automatically.
corrective.closeIntro: A case needs an owner before it can be closed. A closed case is never reopened.
corrective.emptyBody: Cases appear here when a rule fires or a Value Review finding is recorded.
corrective.signalsIntro: Each event that opened or updated this case, by period. An amber, green or Unknown period ends a run; it never closes the case.

rules.title: Corrective-action rules
rules.intro: When a signal opens or updates a corrective action. A rule marked Default uses the built-in setting until it is saved for this transformation.
rules.tableIntro: Severity applies to KPI deviations only. A failed check is one event, so its persistence is 1 cycle.
rules.defaultIntro: This rule uses the default. Saving it stores it for this transformation.

log.title: RAID + decision log
log.intro: Open RAID entries and open design (T04) and executive (T16) decisions, each read from its own record.
log.tableIntro: Each row opens the register that owns it; nothing here is a copy.
